conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query:
(
  sum by (instance_id, tablespace_name) ({"workload.googleapis.com/oracle.tablespace.size", monitored_resource="gce_instance", state="used"})
  /
  sum by (instance_id, tablespace_name) ({"workload.googleapis.com/oracle.tablespace.size", monitored_resource="gce_instance", state=~"used|free"})
) > 0.85

documentation.content: Alert fires when a tablespace should be resized as it approaches high utilization, before an interruption in service occurs.
